title: Cardigann indexer definition
description: Schema for Jackett Cardigann YAML indexer definitions. See the Definition-format page on the Jackett wiki for examples.

SchemaRoot.description: Root of a Cardigann YAML indexer definition: header, caps, settings, login, search and download blocks.

id.title: ID
id.description: Internal name of the indexer. Must be unique. Usually the site name in lower case without special characters or spaces. Used in the Torznab, download and search URLs and in the indexer config file name.

replaces.title: Replaces
replaces.description: Old indexer IDs this definition replaces. Keeps existing configs working after an ID rename. Maintainer use only.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description shown in the tooltip on the add-indexer page and in the config panel. Usually sourced from opentrackers.org when available.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code of the main language used on the tracker, usually from the site's <html lang> attribute.

type.title: Type
type.description: public: no registration required. semi-private: registration required but always open. private: invite or application needed.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Character encoding of the site, usually from its <meta charset> tag.

followredirect.title: Follow redirect
followredirect.description: Automatically update the site URL when the site redirects to a different domain. Default: false.

testlinktorrent.title: Test link torrent
testlinktorrent.description: Pre-test the .torrent download when grabbing. Set to false for sites that reject two GET requests for the same .torrent in sequence. Indexers that support fallback downloading need true. Default: true.

requestDelay.title: Request delay
requestDelay.description: Seconds to wait between requests to the site. Use for sites that temporarily block clients that exceed a request rate.

links.title: Links
links.description: Known site URLs. The first is the default. Each must end with /.

legacylinks.title: Legacy links
legacylinks.description: Old site URLs that no longer work. A configured legacy URL is replaced automatically with the first entry in links.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: SHA-1 fingerprints of untrusted HTTPS certificates (self-signed, expired, etc.) to accept anyway. Rarely needed.

caps.title: Capabilities
caps.description: Category mappings and supported search modes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Config options shown for the indexer. If omitted, username and password are used. Set to [] for public trackers that need no settings.

login.title: Login
login.description: Login configuration. Required only if the tracker needs a login.

search.title: Search
search.description: Search request and result parsing configuration.

download.title: Download
download.description: Download configuration. Only needed for special download handling.

SchemaRoot.title: SchemaRoot

Caps.description: Capabilities of the indexer: category mappings and supported Torznab search modes.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Simple mapping of tracker category ID to Newznab category. Use either this or categorymappings.

categorymappings.title: Category mappings
categorymappings.description: List of tracker-to-Newznab category mappings. Use either this or categories.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Supported Torznab search modes and their parameters.

allowrawsearch.title: Allow raw search
allowrawsearch.description: Enable raw search. See Jackett issue 8246.

allowtvsearchimdb.title: Allow TV search by IMDb ID
allowtvsearchimdb.description: Allow imdbid in tv-search. See Jackett issue 16412.

Caps.title: Caps

CategoryMapping.description: Maps one tracker category to a Newznab/Torznab category.

id.title: ID
id.description: Tracker-specific category ID. Can be a number or a string.

desc.title: Description
desc.description: Tracker category name. If set, it is used for a 1:1 mapping between tracker and Newznab categories.

default.title: Default
default.description: Use this category when the search query has no categories. Default: false.

CategoryMapping.title: CategoryMapping

Modes.description: Torznab search modes and the query parameters the tracker supports for each. Most apps calling Jackett depend on these being correct.

search.title: Search
search.description: Parameters for basic search. q is the minimum and is required.

tv-search.title: TV search
tv-search.description: Parameters supported for TV search. Only list those the tracker can search with.

movie-search.title: Movie search
movie-search.description: Parameters supported for movie search. Only list those the tracker can search with.

music-search.title: Music search
music-search.description: Parameters supported for music search. Only list those the tracker can search with.

book-search.title: Book search
book-search.description: Parameters supported for book search. Only list those the tracker can search with.

Modes.title: Modes

SettingsField.description: One config option shown on the indexer config page. Its value is available to templates as .Config.<name>.

name.title: Name
name.description: Internal variable name. Referenced in templates as .Config.<name>.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display name shown on the config page.

type.title: Type
type.description: Input type. password masks the input. The info_* types show a predefined info box (category 8000, cookie, FlareSolverr, user agent) and need no label.

default.title: Default
default.description: Default value. For checkbox, true ticks it (unticked by default). For info, the text to display. For select, the default option key.

options.title: Options
options.description: Select options as key: display-name pairs.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Default selected option keys for a multi-select.

SettingsField.title: SettingsField

Login.description: How Jackett logs in to the tracker. Omit for sites that need no login.

method.title: Method
method.description: post: send inputs as an HTTP POST. get: same, using HTTP GET. form: fetch path, extract the HTML form (handles CSRF tokens and captchas), then POST it. cookie: use the configured cookie. oneurl: request path with inputs.oneurl appended.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Cookies sent with the post login request.

path.title: Path
path.description: Login target. For post/get it is the request URL. For form it is the page containing the login form.

submitpath.title: Submit path
submitpath.description: Form login only. URL to POST to, when it differs from the form's action attribute.

form.title: Form
form.description: Form login only. Selector for the HTML form element. Default: form.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Login parameters, e.g. username: "{{ .Config.username }}". Fixed values are allowed.

selectors.title: Selectors
selectors.description: Form login only. If true, the keys in inputs are treated as CSS selectors. Only needed for dynamic input names (very rare).

selectorinputs.title: Selector inputs
selectorinputs.description: Form login only. Input values taken from the login page with selectors, e.g. a CSRF token hidden in JavaScript.

getselectorinputs.title: GET selector inputs
getselectorinputs.description: Form login only. Like selectorinputs, but sent in the query string instead of the POST body.

error.title: Error
error.description: Selectors checked on the login response. If one matches, the login failed and the matched text is shown as the error.

test.title: Test
test.description: Page used to confirm the login worked.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with login requests. If omitted, search headers are used.

Login.title: Login

PageTestBlock.description: Page requested after login to confirm the session is valid. A redirect, or no selector match, means the login failed. Also used during searches to detect an expired session and re-login.

path.title: Path
path.description: Page to request, typically the home page or the search page.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: Selector that must match on a logged-in page. Required if the site shows a login form instead of redirecting.

PageTestBlock.title: PageTestBlock

CaptchaBlock.description: Captcha handling for form logins. Google ReCaptcha and simplecaptcha are detected automatically and need no captcha block.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: Selector for the captcha HTML element.

input.title: Input
input.description: Name of the form field that receives the captcha value.

CaptchaBlock.title: CaptchaBlock

ErrorBlock.description: Selector that detects an error on a login or search response. If it matches, the request is treated as failed.

path.title: Path
path.description: Only check responses from this path.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: If this selector matches, the request failed.

message.title: Message
message.description: Selector used to extract the error message to display. Defaults to the text matched by selector.

ErrorBlock.title: ErrorBlock

SelectorBlock.description: Extracts a value from a response using a CSS selector (HTML) or path (JSON/XML), then applies case, remove and filters.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: CSS selector for HTML, or path for JSON/XML. :has(), :not() and :contains() are supported. In JSON, $ refers to the root object and a .. prefix reads from the row instead of the rows attribute subset.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: Take the value of this attribute (e.g. href) instead of the element text.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: Do not fail if the selector does not match. Use with default.

default.title: Default
default.description: Value used when an optional selector does not match. Templates are allowed, e.g. "{{ .Result.title_default }}".

case.title: Case
case.description: Selector: value pairs. The value of the first matching selector is used. "*" matches anything. Common for downloadvolumefactor and uploadvolumefactor.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Selector for elements to remove before reading the text. Removed elements are gone for all later fields, so put fields using remove last.

text.title: Text
text.description: Fixed value, or a template. Used instead of selector, e.g. for minimumratio and minimumseedtime.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filters applied to the extracted value, in order.

allOf.title: Default requires optional
allOf.description: If default is set, optional must be true.

SelectorBlock.title: SelectorBlock

Search.description: How to build search requests and parse torrent results from the response.

path.title: Path
path.description: Single search path. Shorthand for paths with one entry.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Search requests. Usually one. Some trackers need separate pages for e.g. porn or scene releases.

allowEmptyInputs.title: Allow empty inputs
allowEmptyInputs.description: Send inputs whose value resolves to empty. By default such key/value pairs are dropped. Default: false.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: HTTP arguments used by all paths. $raw is appended to the argument list without escaping (only variables are escaped).

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with search requests.

keywordsfilters.title: Keywords filters
keywordsfilters.description: Filters applied to the search keywords. The result is available as .Keywords.

error.title: Error
error.description: Selectors checked on the search response. Same syntax as the login error block.

preprocessingfilters.title: Preprocessing filters
preprocessingfilters.description: Filters applied to the raw response before parsing.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: How to find the result rows.

Search.title: Search

SearchPathBlock.description: One search request. All matching paths are requested and their results combined.

path.title: Path
path.description: Search URL path. Templates and conditionals are allowed.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method: get or post. Templates are allowed. Default: get.

followredirect.title: Follow redirect
followredirect.description: Follow redirects on search requests. If true, set a selector in login.test. Default: false.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Only use this path if the search includes at least one of these tracker categories. A leading "!" inverts the match.

items.title: Tracker category
items.description: Tracker category ID, or "!" as the first entry to invert the match.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Extra HTTP arguments for this path only.

inheritinputs.title: Inherit inputs
inheritinputs.description: Use the search-level inputs as the base for this path's inputs. Default: true.

response.title: Response
response.description: Response type. Required for JSON and XML results.

SearchPathBlock.title: SearchPathBlock

ResponseBlock.description: Response type for non-HTML search results. Omit for HTML, which is the default.

noResultsMessage.title: No results message
noResultsMessage.description: If the response contains this text, or is empty and this is an empty string, return zero results instead of an error. For sites that do not return an empty object or a zero count.

ResponseBlock.title: ResponseBlock

RowsBlock.description: Selects the result rows. Each row is then parsed with the fields block.

after.title: After
after.description: Row merging. Merge this many following elements into each row, for sites that use several elements per torrent (e.g. collapsed rows).

dateheaders.title: Date headers
dateheaders.description: Selector for header rows that hold the date, for sites where result rows have no date. The first previous sibling that matches is parsed as the date.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: Selector for the result rows. For JSON, $ refers to the root object.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: JSON/XML only. Sub-element holding the torrents, when they are nested in each row.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: Do not fail if the selector does not match.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: JSON/XML only. Each row holds several torrents (e.g. one title with several releases).

missingAttributeEqualsNoResults.title: Missing attribute equals no results
missingAttributeEqualsNoResults.description: JSON/XML only. Return zero results instead of an error when attribute is missing.

case.title: Case
case.description: Selector: value pairs. The value of the first matching selector is used.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Selector for elements to remove from each row.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Row filters, e.g. andmatch or strdump.

count.title: Count
count.description: JSON/XML only. Field holding the hit count, so a count of 0 means no results. Omit if the site returns an empty set for no results.

RowsBlock.title: RowsBlock

FieldsBlock.description: Fields extracted from each result row. Names starting with _ are working fields for use in templates via .Result.<name>.

oneOf.title: Category by ID
oneOf.description: Set category, or categorydesc, but not both.

oneOf.title: Category by description
oneOf.description: Set category, or categorydesc, but not both.

anyOf.title: Download link
anyOf.description: At least one of download, infohash or magnet is required.

anyOf.title: Infohash
anyOf.description: At least one of download, infohash or magnet is required.

anyOf.title: Magnet link
anyOf.description: At least one of download, infohash or magnet is required.

FieldsBlock.title: FieldsBlock

DownloadBlock.description: Needed only when the download link cannot be taken directly from the search results, the download must be a POST, or another page must be requested first.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method for the download: get or post. Default: get.

before.title: Before
before.description: Request sent before downloading the file.

selectors.title: Selectors
selectors.description: If set, the search result download URL is fetched and parsed as HTML, and the first selector gives the actual download URL. Later selectors are fallbacks.

infohash.title: Infohash
infohash.description: Build a magnet URI from a hash and title found on the download page.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with download requests.

DownloadBlock.title: DownloadBlock

BeforeBlock.description: HTTP request sent before the download (e.g. a 'thank you' page).

pathselector.title: Path selector
pathselector.description: Take the request target from a link on the details page instead of path.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: HTTP arguments sent with the request, e.g. id: "{{ .DownloadUri.Query.id }}".

BeforeBlock.title: BeforeBlock

InfoHashBlock.description: Builds a magnet URI from an infohash and title. Public and semi-private indexers only: private sites usually require their own tracker and have DHT disabled.

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: Selector for the file hash, used for the magnet xt parameter.

title.title: Title
title.description: Selector for the title, used for the magnet dn parameter.

usebeforeresponse.title: Use before response
usebeforeresponse.description: Take hash and title from the page returned by the before request instead of the search result download link. Default: false.

InfoHashBlock.title: InfoHashBlock

SelectorField.description: Selector applied to the download page to get the download URL, hash or title.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: Take the value of this attribute (e.g. href) instead of the element text.

usebeforeresponse.title: Use before response
usebeforeresponse.description: Apply the selector to the page returned by the before request instead of the search result download link. Default: false.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filters applied to the extracted value, in order.

SelectorField.title: SelectorField

RowFilterBlock.description: Filter applied to the result rows.

name.title: Name
name.description: andmatch: only return rows containing all search words. strdump: log each row's HTML (debugging).

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Filter arguments. For andmatch, an optional maximum title length to compare, for sites that truncate names.

oneOf.title: Arguments as array item as string
Arguments as array item as number
Arguments as array item as boolean

RowFilterBlock.title: RowFilterBlock

FilterBlock.description: Filter applied to an extracted value. See the Filters section of the Definition-format wiki.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Filter arguments: a single value or a list, depending on the filter.

oneOf.title: Arguments as array item as string
Arguments as array item as number
Arguments as array item as boolean

allOf.title: dateparse format check
allOf.description: The dateparse argument must be a format string with no digits.

FilterBlock.title: FilterBlock

IndexerCategories.description: Predefined Newznab/Torznab category name. See the Jackett-Categories wiki page.
IndexerCategories.title: IndexerCategories
